name: Doodle dash
summary: A drawing and guessing game in the chat: one person draws a prompt from the chat on a little sketchbook page in 20 seconds while sand runs out, everyone else types guesses that pop up as bubbles, the fastest right guess scores, and every page goes into a gallery.
useWhen: game night but none of us own a board game
bored, someone start a drawing game
draw arun's rice cooker, i bet nobody gets it
quick game while we wait for the pizza
dontUseWhen: making one shared drawing or poster together (use a creative tool)
a word game with typing only (use word-bomb or letter-sprint)

prompt.description: What to draw, taken from the chat

answer.description: The word or words a right guess must contain

drawer.description: Who draws it (a name in the chat)

gallery.description: Pages already finished, in round order: strokes as flat x,y lists in thousandths of the page, and who guessed it

live.description: The page being drawn now: strokes so far and wrong guesses already in, in people's own words
